Markets.title: Four regional Fed banks backed rate hike ahead of July decision, minutes show
Markets.summary: Ahead of the July meeting, four regional Federal Reserve banks recommended a 25-basis-point increase in the discount rate. This disagreement highlights internal divisions as officials balance persistent inflation with signs of economic weakness.

Markets.title: 14 midcap stocks crash up to 55% from their peaks. Are you holding any?
Markets.summary: Despite the Nifty Midcap 150 trading near record levels, 14 individual midcap stocks have crashed between 30% and 55% from their 52-week highs. This divergence highlights significant underlying weakness in the broader market beneath the resilient index-level performance.

Markets.title: Private credit play: Modulus Alternatives’ third fund crosses Rs 300 crore in first close
Markets.summary: Modulus Alternatives raised over Rs 300 crore in the first close of its third private credit fund, India Credit Opportunities Fund III. The SEBI-registered fund aims for a total corpus of Rs 2,000 crore to invest in performing credit opportunities within high-growth sectors.

Markets.title: Dmart owner eyes debt market comeback after 7-year hiatus, bankers say
Markets.summary: Avenue Supermarts, the owner of Dmart, plans to raise ten billion rupees through three-year corporate bonds. This marks the retailer's first return to the debt market since October 2019.

Markets.title: Global Market: Fiscal dominance debate takes centre stage as government debt mounts
Markets.summary: Rising government debt and borrowing costs are reviving concerns that central banks may face pressure to finance government spending. This debate could significantly impact monetary policy, inflation, currencies, and sovereign bond markets.

Markets.title: Hindustan Zinc vs Hindalco:  Why Jefferies raised target prices for both, but prefers one over the other
Markets.summary: Jefferies raised its target prices for both Hindustan Zinc and Hindalco Industries while giving Hindustan Zinc a "Buy" rating and Hindalco a "Hold." The brokerage favors Hindustan Zinc because of expected strength in zinc and silver prices, whereas it expects Hindalco's performance to be weighed down by softer aluminum prices and higher debt.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods, including steel, furniture, fresh tuna, and makeup. This move marks a significant escalation in the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada.

Geo-Political.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
Geo-Political.summary: China has criticized new United States sanctions targeting Iran and its trading partners as illegal. The United States has threatened to isolate nations that continue to conduct business with Tehran.

Geo-Political.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
Geo-Political.summary: US media reports that the CIA director traveled to Moscow for unannounced talks this week. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft flew to Russia from the United States via Latvia on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
Geo-Political.summary: Law enforcement arrested 39 individuals in South Africa as part of a global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks. The suspects were targeted for their involvement in romance and investment scams.

Geo-Political.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
Geo-Political.summary: A recent study found that at least 25 percent of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 suffered from a degenerative brain disease. Researchers note that the actual rate among deceased players is likely much higher.

Geo-Political.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Geo-Political.summary: A tornado struck the south-western French village of Pomas, damaging hundreds of homes. Fifteen people were hospitalized with injuries.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best courses in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: India’s GDP growth likely slowed to a 4-quarter low of 7.4% in Q1: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's GDP growth is projected to slow to a four-quarter low of 7.4% in the first quarter, according to a Mint poll. While industrial and services sectors supported the economy, agricultural activity likely declined due to a delayed monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: Why does Niti Aayog want to change India’s skilling system?
Data & Insights.summary: Niti Aayog has proposed unifying India's education and training into a single system to prepare workers for future jobs by 2047. This new framework shifts the primary focus of the skilling system from simple certification to actual employment outcomes.

Data & Insights.title: How India’s import dependence is spilling beyond oil, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: India's non-petroleum trade deficit is surging beyond crude oil due to a growing reliance on foreign electronics components and industrial inputs. This trend exposes the country's dependence on assembly rather than deep domestic manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: VCs look past payment figures to spot 'dead users' hiding in UPI autoPay metrics
Data & Insights.summary: Venture capitalists are analyzing underlying app usage rather than relying solely on UPI autoPay transaction volumes. This helps investors identify dormant subscribers and accurately assess the true value of startups.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal offers BIS exemptions to high-tech chipmakers, AI firms to boost ‘Make in India’
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has granted Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) exemptions to semiconductor and artificial intelligence companies. This policy change addresses Japanese concerns and aims to prevent operational delays for advanced technology firms under the "Make in India" initiative.

Data & Insights.title: India plans 100 new ships to cut $75 billion foreign freight bill
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to its fleet to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a major financial hurdle, as operating under the Indian flag is currently 16% to 20% more expensive than operating under foreign flags.

India.title: Boy Survives After Iron Rod Pierces Shoulder, Comes Out Of Mouth In Surat
India.summary: A young boy in Surat survived after falling from a mosque's upper level onto an iron rod that pierced his shoulder and exited through his mouth. The incident occurred while he was playing and attempted to jump to an adjacent under-construction building.

India.title: ICSI CS June 2026: Marks Verification Starts Today, Know Fee, Steps And Deadline
India.summary: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India opened the marks verification window for the June 2026 CS exams on August 26. Dissatisfied candidates can apply for verification by paying the required fee until the September 15 deadline.

India.title: BJP's 2027 Punjab Strategy: Drugs At Centre, Booths On Ground
India.summary: BJP national general secretary BL Santosh instructed Punjab party leaders to organize anti-drug yatras across all 117 Assembly constituencies in September. This initiative forms a key part of the BJP's strategy leading up to the 2027 Punjab elections.

India.title: H1N1 Cases In Delhi: Schools Get Advisory On Masks, Handwashing And Hygiene
India.summary: Delhi schools have received an advisory regarding H1N1 cases, emphasizing masks, handwashing, and hygiene. District education officials must monitor compliance and submit a compiled report by August 31, 2026.

India.title: India Confident Rice Exports To Iran Will Weather US Sanctions
India.summary: India expects its rice exports to Iran to continue without interruption. This is despite ongoing United States sanctions and related trade disruptions.

General.title: The life of an iconic country singer
General.summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80. Her team announced the news on social media.

General.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
General.summary: Regulator Ofgem has announced a 4% rise in household energy bills starting in October. This increase will add £60 a year to the costs of a household using typical amounts of gas and electricity.

General.title: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
General.summary: The father of Chloe Moffat stated that the Treasury failed in its duty of care following her death by suicide last year. She died after denying allegations that she had shared sensitive confidential information about her colleagues.

General.title: Yellow warnings in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
General.summary: Torrential downpours will affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks

General.title: Why Pride is facing a backlash - from inside and outside the LGBT community
General.summary: Major corporations are increasingly hesitant to support Pride events due to growing nervousness. This backlash against Pride is coming from both outside and inside the LGBT community.

General.title: Ex-England footballer Sterling charged with dangerous driving after crashing Lamborghini
General.summary: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling has been charged with dangerous driving after crashing his Lamborghini into motorway barriers in May. He is scheduled to appear in court next month to face the charges.
